value.note: container slot indices in order; player inventory follows after slot 26

rules.topic: Learning: placing an item in an input slot teaches it; the item is NOT consumed
rules.value: On SlotInput.set (server), if the stack has EMC, TransmutationInventory.handleKnowledge(stack) runs and adds the item to the player's knowledge. The stack stays in the slot.

rules.quote: public static boolean doesItemHaveEmc(ItemStack stack) { return getEmcValue(stack) > 0; }
rules.topic: An item can be learned only if its EMC value is > 0
rules.value: doesItemHaveEmc(stack) == (getEmcValue(stack) > 0). Items with no EMC value (or value 0) can never be learned or transmuted.

rules.topic: The consume slot (9) burns items into the player's knowledge EMC pool, and also teaches them
rules.value: SlotConsume.set: handleKnowledge(stack) (learn), then provider EMC pool += getEmcSellValue(stack) * stack count. Sell value = floor(EMC * difficulty.covalenceLoss), config default covalenceLoss = 1.0 (full value). Taking items from output slots spends from the same pool (provider.getEmc(), a BigInteger).

rules.quote: if (info.getItem() instanceof Tome) { ... knowledge.add(info); fullKnowledge = true;
rules.topic: Learning the Tome of Knowledge grants full knowledge
rules.value: KnowledgeImpl.addKnowledge: if the learned item is a Tome, fullKnowledge is set to true — every item with an EMC value counts as known. Unlearning the Tome clears the flag.

rules.quote: Loads json files within datapacks (data/<domain>/pe_custom_conversions/*.json) to add values and conversions
rules.value: Values are computed by a graph mapper: seed values (setValueBefore) plus recipe/conversion graph resolution. Built-in seeds ship as a datapack JSON (data/projecte/pe_custom_conversions/defaults.json in the jar); datapacks can add/override via data/<domain>/pe_custom_conversions/*.json. Most ingots/products are NOT seeds — their values are derived from recipes.

Antimatter Relay charge rate and internal storage by tier (EMC)
Klein Star EMC capacities by tier (Ein, Zwei, Drei, Vier, Sphere, Omega)

rules.value: Target-driven: requiredEmc is the locked target item's EMC value. Input items are consumed into the condenser's stored EMC; when stored EMC >= requiredEmc and the output has space, requiredEmc is extracted and one target item is produced. MK2 extends the same block entity with automation I/O (WrappedItemHandler input). No external power is involved.

rules.topic: Output ring display: paging buttons, search filter, and the lock shortcut

value.display: Client-side (updateClientTargets returns immediately on the server): learned items with EMC > 0, sorted by EMC descending, items costing more than the available pool hidden; 16 output slots filled per view.
value.paging: The GUI's '<' and '>' buttons decrement/increment the public field TransmutationInventory.searchpage; each page step skips 12 entries (pages overlap by 4). Paging is client presentation state, not server state.
value.filter: The GUI search box sets the public field TransmutationInventory.filter (lowercase substring match on the item's display name) and resets searchpage to 0.
value.lock_shortcut: If a lock item is set and known, it is pinned into the outputs at slot 0 (matter) or the fuel start slot — takeable immediately without paging. Without a sample to lock, an item must be paged/filtered into view before its output slot can be clicked.
value.taking: SlotOutput.remove checks the stack's EMC against the available pool and deducts it server-side (inv.removeEmc).
